name: zeffect_anim_find_or_create_light_ref
description: zEffectAnim::FindOrCreateLightRef resolves an existing light ref or creates and appends a runtime light ref.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffectAnim runtime-ref/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x45e4a0 validates existing-ref lookup, gwLightNew allocation, node-name binding, list allocation growth, overflow handling, runtime-node/isAttached fields, count update, and new index return.

The native smoke verifies creating the first nonzero light ref, preserving the zero sentinel slot, binding the runtime node name, incrementing the count, and returning the existing index on repeat lookup.
